# Atomic, molecular and optical physics

Open only the cards whose "Applies when" line matches the paper. Paths are relative to this folder; the index of all folders is [../../INDEX.md](../../INDEX.md).

| Id | Card | Applies when |
|---|---|---|
| T-ATOM-INTERFEROMETRY | [Atom interferometry](atom-interferometry.md) | the paper measures gravity, a gravity gradient, rotation, acceleration, photon recoil or a fundamental constant with a light-pulse, Raman, Bragg or guided atom interferometer, or bases an equivalence-principle or new-physics test on atom-interferometer phases |
| T-ATOMIC-CLOCKS | [Atomic clocks and frequency metrology](atomic-clocks.md) | the paper reports the frequency, systematic uncertainty or instability of an optical or microwave atomic clock, a comparison between clocks or a frequency ratio, or bases a claim about fundamental constants, relativity or geodesy on clock measurements |
| T-ATOMIC-MAGNETOMETRY | [Atomic magnetometers](atomic-magnetometry.md) | the paper measures magnetic fields with an optically pumped or spin-exchange-relaxation-free alkali or helium vapour magnetometer, or reports such a sensor's sensitivity, noise floor, bandwidth, calibration, heading error or a comparison with other magnetic sensors |
| T-ATTOSECOND-PHYSICS | [Attosecond physics and high-harmonic generation](attosecond-physics.md) | the paper reports high-harmonic spectra, cut-offs, photon flux or conversion efficiency, characterises attosecond pulses or pulse trains by RABBITT, streaking or related retrieval, measures photoemission time delays, or depends on carrier-envelope phase stabilisation or CEP-dependent signals |
| T-QUANTUM-GASES | [Bose-Einstein condensates and degenerate Fermi gases](quantum-gases.md) | the paper reports a Bose-Einstein condensate, a degenerate Fermi gas or a pair condensate of ultracold atoms, or bases a claim about condensate fraction, temperature, degeneracy, atom number, scattering length or superfluidity on absorption or time-of-flight images |
| T-CAVITY-QED | [Cavity quantum electrodynamics](cavity-qed.md) | the paper couples atoms to an optical or microwave cavity mode and reports a coupling strength, cooperativity, vacuum Rabi or normal-mode splitting, strong coupling, Purcell enhancement, cavity-enhanced emission or single-photon nonlinearities of an atom-cavity system |
| T-COLD-MOLECULES | [Cold and ultracold molecules](cold-molecules.md) | the paper laser-cools molecules or holds them in a magneto-optical, magnetic, optical or tweezer trap, forms them from ultracold atoms by magnetoassociation or stimulated Raman adiabatic passage, or reports the number, temperature, degeneracy, internal-state purity, trap lifetime or collisional loss of cold molecules |
| T-FESHBACH-RESONANCES | [Collisions and Feshbach resonances](feshbach-resonances.md) | the paper locates or characterises a Feshbach resonance in ultracold atoms, reports a scattering length, a two- or three-body loss rate coefficient or an Efimov feature, or bases a claim on atom-loss spectroscopy or on interactions tuned by a magnetic field |
| T-STORAGE-RINGS | [Ion storage rings and highly charged ions](storage-rings-hci.md) | the paper studies highly charged ions in a heavy-ion storage ring, electron beam ion trap or Penning trap and reports transition energies, line identifications, recombination resonances or rate coefficients, lifetimes, masses, g-factors or comparisons with bound-state quantum electrodynamics |
| T-LASER-COOLING | [Laser cooling and trapping of neutral atoms](laser-cooling.md) | the paper reports atom numbers, temperatures, densities, phase-space densities, trap frequencies, trap depths or lifetimes of laser-cooled or evaporatively cooled neutral atoms in a magneto-optical trap, optical molasses or optical dipole trap, or bases a claim on fluorescence, absorption, time-of-flight or release-and-recapture measurements |
| T-OPTICAL-LATTICES | [Optical lattices and quantum-gas microscopy](optical-lattices.md) | the paper holds ultracold atoms in an optical lattice or images them site by site, and bases a claim on lattice depth, a superfluid or Mott-insulating state, lattice temperature or entropy, spin or density correlations, or simulation of a Hubbard-type model |
| T-LEVITATED-OPTOMECHANICS | [Optical tweezers and levitated optomechanics](levitated-optomechanics.md) | the paper traps a particle in an optical tweezer in gas or vacuum, or in liquid other than as a handle for single-molecule, motor or microrheology measurements, and reports a trap stiffness, calibrated force, motional temperature or occupation, heating rate, or force or acceleration sensitivity |
| T-PRECISION-SPECTROSCOPY | [Precision spectroscopy and frequency combs](precision-spectroscopy.md) | the paper reports an absolute transition frequency, line centre or isotope or fine-structure interval from laser or microwave spectroscopy, other than an atomic clock's own frequency, or derives a fundamental constant, nuclear charge radius or test of theory from such frequencies |
| T-RYDBERG-ATOMS | [Rydberg atoms and atom arrays](rydberg-atoms.md) | the paper excites atoms to Rydberg states, uses Rydberg blockade or interactions, assembles atoms in optical tweezer arrays, reports Rydberg excitation, preparation, detection, entanglement or gate fidelities, or measures electric fields with Rydberg atoms in vapour cells |
| T-STRONG-FIELD-IMAGING | [Strong-field ionization and momentum imaging](strong-field-imaging.md) | the paper reports electron or ion momentum distributions, yields or coincidences from strong-field or multiphoton ionisation, measured by velocity-map imaging, a reaction microscope or another coincidence spectrometer, or bases a claim on laser peak intensity, intensity dependence or correlated fragment momenta |
| T-TRAPPED-IONS | [Trapped ions](trapped-ions.md) | the paper confines ions in a radio-frequency (Paul) or Penning trap and reports motional temperature, heating rates, micromotion, sideband cooling, state preparation or detection fidelity, coherence times, quantum gate fidelities, or transition frequencies measured on trapped ions |
